system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: Ruler]

Using a centimeter ruler like this one, you can measure accurately to the nearest

Figure, described in words:
A centimeter ruler labeled "cm" at the left, with major tick marks numbered from 1 to 11. Between each pair of consecutive whole-centimeter marks (and between 0 and 1), there is exactly one intermediate, unnumbered tick mark of medium length indicating each half-centimeter. There are no smaller millimeter subdivision marks.

A. millimeter
B. half-millimeter
C. centimeter
D. half-centimeter

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer

llm_thinking: Since the ruler only has half-centimeter marks, measurements can only be read to the nearest half-centimeter, so the answer is D.
